title: A decision-making framework for neuromodulation modalities in psychiatric disorders
abstract: Nature Mental Health, Published online: 12 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s44220-026-00758-7 The evolution of psychiatric neuromodulation aims to precisely modulate dysfunctional brain circuits for therapeutic benefit yet lacks direct comparative trials and consensus criteria. This Perspective presents evidence that neuromodulation tools engage shared neural networks, proposing an evidence-based framework for optimizing circuit-based therapies and shaping future mental health care.
